title: contracts/i18n.json
description: The app's translation policy, read by the i18n-strings-and-catalogs checkers and scripts/i18n/. The languages themselves live in src/i18n/languages.ts.

untranslatedPrefixes.description: Key prefixes whose texts stay the source text in every language (developer-only screens).

reviewLanguages.description: Languages whose drafted texts go on the non-blocking review queue.

isolatedFormatters.description: Functions whose result already carries bidi isolates (nested-isolates rule).

catalogs.description: When multi-package: package catalog folders and their key prefixes.

dir.description: Repo-relative folder holding <lang>.json for every language.

sourceDir.description: Repo-relative source folder whose '<keyPrefix>.' literals must exist in the catalog.
